messages:
samira-newhire: Hi all :wave: Quick questions after finishing onboarding forms1. My benefits confirmation email shows medical effective 09/01 but my offer said benefits start on your first day (8/15). Which is correct? 2. I selected HSA contributions but it looks like payroll deducted full-month for Sept even though I enrolled 8/20 . Will contributions be prorated? 3. My home mailing address in Workday is still my old CA address which might trigger CA withholding; I moved to OR. Anyone I should ping to change state tax? 4. Commuter card activation link hasn't arrived. 

marta-peopleops: Hey @samira-newhire congrats and welcome! For each: (1) carriers sometimes set the effective date to the 1st of the month after enrollment if enrollment completed after the carriers cutover. Send me your enrollment timestamp and I'll escalate. (2) HSA/401k elections are prorated in payroll if the election change occurred mid-pay-period; we'll verify with payroll. (3) Update your home address in Workday immediately and upload proof of OR residency (utility bill/lease) to the docs tab; @payroll-bot will pick it up for state withholding changes. (4) Commuter card: we push activation emails from our vendor. I'll open a ticket with them. Can you DM me your employee ID?

payroll-bot: Automated note: State withholding changes triggered in Workday before payroll cutoff (T-7 days) will take effect next pay period. To request retroactive state change for a recent payroll, submit a delta payroll request via https://payroll.redwood.internal/delta (internal). Changing withholding mid-cycle may require Form W-4 or state equivalent.

ben-team: @marta if samira enrolled 8/20 the carrier might retroactive to 8/15 depending on plan rules. We need enrollment timestamp and enrollment confirmation pdf. For HSA: contributions follow the payroll schedule; we can run an off-cycle adjustment if needed once payroll confirms the over/under.

samira-newhire: Thanks marta, sent DM with emp ID and attached the Workday confirmation PDF. Enrollment timestamp shows 2024-08-20T14:03:00Z. Also uploaded OR lease to docs tab. Commuter card vendor ticket request number: COM-7192.

marta-peopleops: Received 1. I've escalated to benefits (ticket BEN-2290) and to payroll for a proration check. Next steps: benefits confirms effective date with carrier; payroll confirms whether they prorated HSA for 8/15-8/31 or if an adjustment needed. If payroll needs us to request manual adjustment we will submit with code "payroll-adj-benefits" and you may see it as Other Compensation on your stub.

payroll-bot: Note: Manual payroll adjustments may be taxable depending on type. Contact payroll@redwood for specifics. Expected turnaround 1-2 pay cycles for standard adjustments.

it-helpdesk: Re commuter card: vendor COM-7192 shows activation email bounced due to a spam filter. @samira-newhire can you whitelist notifications@commuter.vendor.com or check spam? We resent the activation link.

samira-newhire: Found the activation email in Promotions tab, thanks! One last Q: does enrolling HSA automatically create the bank transfer? Or do I need to link an account?

ben-team: HSA set-up: the payroll deduction will be sent to our HSA custodian. If it's your first time with this custodian you may need to create a member portal account for transfers/claims. We'll include the custodian signup URL in BEN-2290 notes.

marta-peopleops: Closing loop here: BEN-2290 updated with carrier reply pending (expected 48-72h). Payroll will update on proration by EOD next pay cycle. If anything urgent DM me and we'll escalate. Welcome again 44b
